verdict.rationale: sevDesk is an accounting and invoicing SaaS, not an AI agent or assistant host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external tool servers is outside its product role. Nothing in the evidence shows an agentic assistant that could consume MCP tools; the only automation documented is booking-category suggestions. The REST API it exposes is a server-side integration surface, not client-side MCP consumption.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
